content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Both notifications have the same application and fee-payment window. Candidates should monitor the Careers section of J&K Bank's official website for examination dates, call letters and subsequent updates.

rows.event: Last Date for Online Fee Payment

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Vacancy 2026 - 1053 Posts
content_sections.text: Reservation will be implemented according to the applicable rules of the respective Union Territory. The notifications provide reservation percentages but do not publish a complete category-wise allocation of the 1,033 and 20 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Both posts require a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a university recognized by the Government of India or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government or UGC. Candidates must possess a valid graduation marksheet or degree certificate by 26 November 2026 , the last date of online registration. Applicants must enter their graduation marks percentage while applying. Candidates whose universities award CGPA or OGPA must convert their grades into percentages according to the university's official conversion formula and provide documentary proof when required. Final-year students who have not completed their graduation by 26 November 2026 do not satisfy the prescribed qualification cut-off. Candidates must have documentary proof that they are graduates by the registration closing date. Yes. The recruitment is restricted to candidates domiciled in the respective Union Territory. Selected candidates must submit a valid domicile certificate issued by the competent authority during the prescribed verification process.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The base age limit for both Banking Associate and Probationary Officer is 20 to 30 years as on 1 January 2026 , before applicable relaxation. Special Benefit for Former J&K Bank Apprentices: Domiciled J&K candidates who successfully completed apprenticeship training with J&K Bank receive one additional year of age relaxation, over and above applicable category relaxation. Important: Under Ladakh General Administration Department Order No. 280-LA(GAD) of 2025 dated 30 June 2025, an additional five-year relaxation is available as a one-time special dispensation for eligible recruitments conducted during 2025 and 2026. This includes eligible unreserved and reserved-category candidates. The total permissible relaxation is subject to the condition that the candidate's maximum age does not exceed 56 years. Applicants should apply the stated relaxation rules to their actual category and date of birth.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Separate application fees are prescribed for Banking Associate and Probationary Officer recruitment. All stated fees are exclusive of GST and applicable bank transaction charges. Payment Mode: Online through the application payment gateway using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS or accepted mobile wallet/payment facilities. Last Date for Fee Payment: 26 November 2026. The application fee is non-refundable. Registration is considered complete only after successful online fee payment.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Banking Associate Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Banking Associates will receive a starting basic pay of Rs. 24,050 per month under the notified Banking Associate pay scale, along with applicable allowances and other benefits.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Probationary Officers will receive a starting basic pay of Rs. 48,480 per month under Junior Management Grade Scale-I. Salary Clarification: The amounts above are starting basic pay figures, not guaranteed in-hand salaries. Actual monthly earnings depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Banking Associate Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The Banking Associate recruitment involves an online examination conducted by IBPS , followed by provisional selection and document verification according to the bank's recruitment rules. The notification does not prescribe a separate interview or Main Examination for Banking Associates. Exam Language: English. Negative Marking: One-fourth of the marks assigned to an incorrectly answered question will be deducted. Candidates must qualify in each section and meet the overall cut-off decided by IBPS in concurrence with J&K Bank. These are minimum qualifying standards. The actual category-wise selection cut-offs may be higher. Candidates domiciled in J&K who successfully completed apprenticeship training with J&K Bank will be awarded additional marks equal to 2.5% of the maximum marks in the online examination, as prescribed by the notification. For the 100-mark online examination, this corresponds to 2.5 marks. This benefit is separate from the additional one-year age relaxation available to eligible former bank apprentices.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The Probationary Officer recruitment consists of three stages: Preliminary Online Examination. Main Online Examination, including Objective and Descriptive Papers. Personal Interview. Shortlisting to the Main Examination is generally limited to ten times the vacancies in each category, while shortlisting for interview is limited to three times the vacancies in each category, subject to the bank's recruitment provisions. The Preliminary Examination is conducted in English and has separately timed sections. Minimum Aggregate Qualifying Marks: 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved categories, subject to overall merit and sectional cut-offs. Important: The PO Main Examination includes a descriptive paper assessing essay writing and comprehension, potentially covering economic, social, banking, technology, ethics and current-affairs topics. Negative marking of one-fourth of the marks assigned to each incorrect objective question applies to both Preliminary and Main Examinations. Final merit will be calculated using the Main Examination and Interview in an 80:20 ratio . Candidates must qualify in both stages. Preliminary Examination marks are used for shortlisting and do not form part of the final merit calculation.

content_sections.text: Reservation differs between the two recruitments because Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh follow separate Union Territory rules. content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 Service Bond and Posting Conditions
content_sections.text: Important: Selected candidates must remain posted within their initially allotted zone for at least five years. Transfer outside that zone will not be permitted during the prescribed period, according to the respective notification. The service bond is separate from the five-year zone-retention condition.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for J&K Bank Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Class 10 certificate or accepted date-of-birth proof. Graduation degree certificate and marksheets. University CGPA/OGPA conversion certificate, where applicable. J&K or Ladakh domicile certificate, as required. Valid category/reservation certificate, where applicable. EWS certificate valid for 2026–27, if applicable. PwBD certificate and UDID-related records, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen service documents, if applicable. J&K Bank apprenticeship completion proof, if claiming Banking Associate benefits. Recent passport-size photograph. Signature and other uploads prescribed by the application portal. Valid photo identity proof. Online application printout and fee receipt. Additional supporting documents requested during verification. Original documents and photocopies must be produced when required by the bank. A candidate's eligibility is provisional until verified by the recruiting authority.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in J&K Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. has announced a total of 1053 vacancies for Banking Associates and Probationary Officers under advertisement numbers JKB/HR/Rectt/2026-493 & 494. Candidates can apply online through the official website.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive offers two positions: Banking Associate with 1033 vacancies and Probationary Officer with 20 vacancies. Both roles require candidates to possess a graduate degree from a recognized university along with required domicile credentials.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 7 November 2026 and concludes on 26 November 2026. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute technical glitches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for either the Banking Associate or Probationary Officer post must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Additional specific certificates like domicile documents are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for J&K Bank recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts requires candidates to be a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 30 years old. Upper age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by Document Verification for Banking Associates. For Probationary Officers, an additional Interview round is conducted after clearing the online examination and document check.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Banking Associates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600/- for SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM candidates applying for the Banking Associate position, while all other categories are required to pay Rs. 800/- through the online payment mode.

faq.question: Q8. Are candidates from other states eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, only domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and the Union Territory of Ladakh are eligible to apply for these positions as per the special conditions outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What salary can selected candidates expect?
faq.answer: Banking Associates receive a basic pay of Rs. 24,050/- in a structured scale, whereas Probationary Officers start with a basic pay of Rs. 48,480/- in their respective scale along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to visit the official website at https://jkb.bank.in/, navigate to the careers section, complete the registration, fill out the online application form, upload necessary documents, and pay the fee online.
